pages.text: These are $(item)Armor sets$() worn by the $(thing)Guardians of light$() in $(lissa)Birth by Sleep$(). The armor once protected its wearer from the $(lissa)darkness$() surrounding the lanes between, now it protects you in combat. If you craft its $(item)Pauldron$(), you can store an entire set inside it and place it into the $(l:kingdomkeys:learning_the_menu/item_tab)Pauldron Slot$(), to then summon your Armor with $(thing)[$(k:key.kingdomkeys.summonarmor)]$().

These armor sets can be crafted in the style of $(#cc7a22)Terra$(), $(#335cc1)Aqua$(), $(#80d11d)Ventus$(), $(#b6b6c9)Eraqus$(), $(#5d5d5d)Xehanort$() and $(#1a1827)Ventus' Nightmare form$(). Get in a Smithing Table and combine some netherite armor and an upgrade template with an $(#cc7a22)orange$(), $(#335cc1)blue$(), $(#80d11d)lime green$(), $(#b6b6c9)white$() or $(#5d5d5d)gray$() and $(#1a1827)black$() dye.
